description.value:
The wolf was never meant to hunt alone. Biotechnica's de-extinction form is sold in packs: Synced Reflexes link you to the rest of your crew, and the discount for six is the best deal at the Zoo.

Package: Major
Humanity Loss: 28
Includes: Exotic Bodysculpting (heavy-boned wolf), Adrenaline Convertor, Chipware Socket w/ Olfactory Boost (permanent), Combat Jaw, Cybereye ×2 w/ LL/IR/UV ×2, Cyberleg ×2 w/ Lynx Paws and Reinforced Tendons, Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace, Synced Reflexes

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
